checkpoints.description: [1/3] failing-first shape tests: the fused read_char path is mov rax,[rip+cursor]; cmp rax,[rip+end]; jae drain; movzx eax,[rax]; inc qword [rip+cursor] - five instructions, no lea, no SIB, and the pointer state is cursor/end; assembler byte pins for cmp reg,[rip] and inc [rip]; [2/3] runtime.py stores a cursor pointer and an end pointer (refill sets end = buffer + count) and the helper's have path loads through the cursor; codegen.py fuses the pointer shape; [3/3] suite, stdin e2e (EOF, refill, large pipe, closed stdin), user-code byte identity on the 18 non-char cases plus a diff confined to the read_char helper span, interleaved A/B on char_stream, honest gate, ADR-077, SPEC row and README

impact_assessment.why: char_stream is the largest recorded gap: 1.38x to C. The fused have path is eight instructions with two taken branches and a store-to-load forwarding chain on the cursor index; glibc's getc fast path is four instructions over buffer pointers. The index form additionally spends one lea loading the buffer base and one lea addressing the cursor, which the pointer form removes
impact_assessment.benefits: the have path drops from 8 instructions to 5 (51 to 35 bytes), the dependent chain shortens by one lea+load pair per byte, and read_char's helper gets the same pointer shape on its rare drain path; expected char_stream from 11.8 ms toward C's 8.5; every read_char user benefits, not just the benchmark
impact_assessment.risks: contract: read_char's observable answers must not change (byte, -1 at EOF, repeated -1, one syscall per call at a true end), and inc leaves CF alone where add set it, so any CF consumer across a call would change; dependency: no new encodings beyond cmp reg,[rip] and inc [rip], whose disp32 is the last field so the existing fixup rule stays valid; concurrency: single-threaded; state: the two writable globals change meaning (index/count to pointer/end), which is internal, but every image's helper bytes change, so byte identity must be argued per region
impact_assessment.mitigation: falling-first encoding and fusion-shape tests; the existing IR differential corpus and the four stdin end-to-end tests cover the contract; a probe compares user-code regions across all 19 registry cases and reports the differing ranges, which must lie inside the runtime span; interleaved same-seconds A/B on char_stream with a non-stdin negative control; honest gate with the 10 percent band

impact_assessment.why: the generic binary tail always parks the computed left and evaluates a pure homed right into rax; the mirror of the existing homed-left rule removes that park, and mandelbrot's inner loop paid a push/pop pair per iteration for it

impact_assessment.risks: contract: evaluation order must stay left-then-right with the right read as a pure home; a call-bearing left is refused because extra homes are caller-saved; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: emitted bytes change in nqueens and mandelbrot only

checkpoints.description: [1/2] absolute-path measurement of gcc's mandelbrot inner loop and its division shape; [2/2] implement the cmov quotient form, verify it, and decide on evidence

impact_assessment.why: mandelbrot is the largest per-case gap to C (1.1x) and its inner loop divides by 2**20 every iteration, where gcc's cmov-shaped quotient looked one instruction and one cycle better
impact_assessment.benefits: a shorter quotient shape on every x / 2**k with an unknown sign, and a disassembly-backed account of where mandelbrot's time actually goes
impact_assessment.risks: contract: the quotient must stay exactly truncating for negative dividends, or the differential corpus and every twin catches it; dependency: none (lea_imm, cmov and test already exist); concurrency: none; state: emitted bytes change for every unknown-sign power-of-two quotient
impact_assessment.mitigation: falling-first shape tests for the cmov form, the wide-power fallback and the remainder chain; the IR differential corpus plus twin parity for semantics; the registry gate, a cycle-count microbenchmark with an identical-binary control, and an objdump comparison against gcc
